intro: Past Efforts in Warsong Gulch is a military commendation turned in to capital city officers in recognition of service on the front lines. Rather than celebrating outright conquest, it honors veterans who offered valiant struggle and sacrifice amidst the contested woods of Ashenvale. City commanders accept these tokens to sustain war morale and reward dedication across both factions.

paras: Ah, yes! Of course we wouldn't forget about your past accomplishments in Warsong Gulch.
